elements.requirement: The rules governing the disclosure period in subsection (2) apply where a restriction order under section 59 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 is made in respect of a person further to the making of a compulsion order mentioned in subsection (1) of that section.

elements.requirement: The disclosure period applicable to a restriction order under section 59 begins with the date of the conviction in respect of which the compulsion order was made and ends on the date the restriction order ceases or ceased to have effect.
elements.quote: The disclosure period applicable to the restriction order is a period beginning with the date of the person's conviction in respect of which the compulsion order was made and ending on the date the restriction order ceases or ceased to have effect.

elements.requirement: The rules governing the disclosure period in subsection (4) apply where, by virtue of section 57(1)(b) of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995, a compulsion order authorising hospital detention is made under subsection (2)(a) and an additional restriction order is made under subsection (2)(b) in relation to a person.

elements.requirement: Where an order listed in subsection (6) was made in relation to a person in respect of a conviction, the disclosure period applicable to the sentence begins with the date of the conviction and ends on the date a relevant sentence in respect of the conviction is imposed on that person.
